transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess what scared me enough to come in is that I've been hearing things. Just my name, really. I keep hearing it called from the hallway at home. And it happened once at the warehouse where I work, when nobody was even around. I don't know, it just... it sounds as real as my husband standing right next to me.
When you hear your name being called, is it ever telling you to do something?
No. It's just my name. That's it.
Have you been using any alcohol or drugs recently?
No. I don't drink. And I don't use drugs.
Have you been seeing anything unusual that isn't really there?
No... I haven't seen anything. Just the hearing.
How long have you been hearing your name being called?
About three weeks, I guess. The whole thing... going from being all wound up and restless, to hearing my name... and then just crashing. It's been going on for about three weeks.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are disjointed or not making sense?

Sometimes... yeah. It just goes fast. Like... my mind will jump from the warehouse orders at work, to yarn colors, or my bills... and then just old family names. I don't really know. It just moves so fast that I lose track of what I even started doing.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yeah... lately. After all that running around and arguing with everyone, I just... I dropped. It's this heavy, empty feeling. I just sit at the kitchen table and cry over nothing. It's like I can't get myself back.
Have you recently experienced a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable and had a lot of energy?

I suppose so. At first... I felt really fired up. Like nothing could stop me from getting my craft business going, and fixing the rules around the house. But... yeah, I was irritable, too. I kept snapping at my husband over tiny things. I just felt like he was trying to hold me back.
Do you believe that someone or something is plotting against you?
No... I don't think so. I mean... people get in my way sometimes, but... no one is plotting anything. I don't really know what you mean.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by feeling 'fired up' at the beginning of all this?

I don't know... just... busy, I guess. I'd get home from my shift at the warehouse and... I just couldn't sit still. I was tearing through closets, rewriting schedules... looking up genealogy records and making all these lists. I just... couldn't stop moving.
Did this period of feeling 'fired up' and having a lot of energy happen at the same time as your hearing your name being called, or was it before that started?

It was... at the same time. When I was doing all that stuff... the closets, the lists, talking my husband's ear off and barely sleeping... that's when I heard it. Just... my name. But before I got all fired up... no. And not now, either. Now that I'm just... tired and don't want to do anything... I don't hear it anymore. Just... back then.
Do you think you might go through another period of feeling 'fired up' and having a lot of energy again in the future?
I don't know. I guess... maybe? It's hard to say. I'm just so tired right now, it's hard to imagine feeling like that again.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling and crying over nothing?
I guess... maybe around three months? It's just been... hanging over me. But it got a lot worse... harder to deal with... just in the last few weeks.
Do you think your periods of feeling 'fired up' and then crashing into feeling empty and sad might happen in a repeating cycle?
I don't know. I haven't really... thought about it like that. I just know how I feel right now.
Have you had other times in your life when you felt extremely happy or irritable and had a lot of energy, followed by periods of feeling sad or empty?
I'm not really sure... I don't think so. I haven't really paid attention to all that. It's just... hard to remember anything past how I feel right now.
Have you experienced periods of feeling extremely happy or irritable with a lot of energy before this current episode?
I... no. Like I just said, I really don't think so. I just go to work, do my shifts, and come home. I haven't noticed feeling like that.
Have you had more than one episode in your life where you felt extremely happy or irritable with a lot of energy, followed by periods of feeling sad or empty?
I feel like... you keep asking me the exact same thing. No. I haven't. I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Can you describe the longest period of time you felt extremely happy or irritable with a lot of energy?
I can't describe it. Because... like I just said, it hasn't happened. There isn't any period of time to tell you about. I just... I don't have times like that.
Did your period of feeling 'fired up' and having a lot of energy last for at least one week?
I never said I felt fired up. I... I don't really know why we're still on this. Like I just told you, I don't get like that. So, no. Not for a week, or... at all.
